limits: Ideal functional primitive model, without SDF, metastability, real PLL, insertion delays or hardware phase measurement.
Each run ends after 22.1003 us and repeats the public reset once; no USB controller or packets.
The four phases shift the 960 MHz input relative to the fixed 60 MHz input; phase 0.520833333 ns aligns their rising edges ideally.
HCLK_FIRST labels every HCLK edge before the first observed sclk edge, not only the first.
Startup before the explicit calibration pulse is not used to claim phase qualification.
conclusion: The divider phase is reconstructed by restart of gated HCLK after CLKDIV reset was released while HCLK was stopped. It is not determined by an independent free-running divider plus asynchronous reset release. The model with ideally aligned 60/960 rising edges has ~5*960-period phase; physical phase still needs measurement/contract.
